about: Worked cases for the readings of part 3 (followers, account tier, account origin, group lead), read by
server/tests/test_pulse_demography.py and src/lib/pulseDemography.test.js. A change on one side fails the other.
Posts: an entry with "times": n stands for n posts (an "id" gets -1, -2, ...; "{i}" in "author" becomes 01, 02, ...).
Expected shares are written as fractions ("3/11") and compared as numbers. `followers` cases list the figure of each account key.
`origin` cases compare the keys listed in `only` (all when absent); a tone is written as {analysed, unknown}, an absent location or based-in as null, and the `post` of a row is not compared.
`tier_of` cases list the tier of each post, with the followers read from the posts of the case; `country_of` cases list the group of each "based in" value.

`shares` cases list the shares a page prints from the readings: followers known over social posts and over their known interactions, provinces read and each country group or province over every X account; null when the base is empty.
`lead` cases compare the whole group_lead reading; `lead_sentences` cases are written by the browser only (platform keys named Instagram, TikTok, Threads, X).

rules.name: followers
rules.text: Pengikut sebuah akun adalah angka pada postingan akun itu yang paling baru dikumpulkan dan melaporkan jumlah pengikut; tanpa waktu pengumpulan, angka yang lebih besar; angka yang bukan bilangan bulat nol atau lebih dianggap tidak dilaporkan.

rules.name: tier
rules.text: Postingan berita membentuk baris Pemberitaan; postingan media sosial masuk ke golongan menurut pengikut akunnya: 1 jt atau lebih, 100 rb sampai di bawah 1 jt, 10 rb sampai di bawah 100 rb, 1 rb sampai di bawah 10 rb, di bawah 1 rb, atau pengikut tidak diketahui.

rules.name: origin
rules.text: Asal akun X dibaca dari lokasi yang ditulis pemiliknya dan negara tempat tinggal yang disebut platform, pada postingan akun itu yang paling baru dikumpulkan; akun yang belum ditanyakan, yang tidak menulis lokasi, dan yang lokasinya tidak menyebut provinsi dihitung terpisah.

rules.name: lead
rules.text: Kalimat pembuka disusun dari angka golongan akun, tanpa model, bila sedikitnya dua golongan bisa dibandingkan. Golongan dengan posting terbanyak atau interaksi terbesar disebut hanya bila selisihnya dengan golongan berikutnya lebih besar dari bagian akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui; bila bagian itu sama dengan atau lebih besar dari golongan teratas, yang disebut adalah bagian itu dan dua platform terbesarnya. Golongan paling negatif disebut bila sedikitnya dua golongan punya 20 postingan yang dianalisis atau lebih dan golongan itu punya postingan negatif; bila akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui juga punya 20 postingan yang dianalisis, golongan itu disebut paling negatif di luar akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui, dan nada akun tersebut ditambahkan bila lebih negatif. Provinsi dengan akun X terbanyak disebut bila sedikitnya 10 akun terbaca provinsinya.

a smaller figure collected later replaces a larger one
no collection time on either: the larger figure, in either order
the same collection time: the larger figure
first_observed_at stands in where crawled_at is missing
a post with a collection time is later than one without
only a whole number of zero or more, or digits, is a count
one account under two spellings, a post without an author, and an id-keyed platform

tiers.note: one account whose figure is 900, then 1200, then missing is in 1k-10k
without collection times the larger figure counts
a smaller figure collected later moves the account down
a news post is Pemberitaan whatever its followers
Threads, a post without an author, and a large account; post shares add up to one
a tier whose interactions are unknown on every post has no value and no share
the bounds are inclusive at the lower end
the three accounts with the most interactions, an account by the sum of its posts

a dozen accounts of equal standing: three named, by account key
every row at once keeps the order of the tiers

tier_of.note: a news post is Pemberitaan whatever its followers; a social post takes its account's figure, the bounds inclusive at the lower end
no figure, no account, a figure that is not a count, or a platform that reports none: unknown
every post of an account is in the tier of the account's latest collected figure
an account keyed by id is one account under two names

origin.note: the base splits; other platforms are ignored
the most recently collected post wins, one that carries no location does not erase it
an account that was asked later than it was first seen: the later post says it, an empty text included
an account with no dated post is still counted
no collection time on either post: the larger text wins, in either order
one account under two spellings is one account; "based in" is compared without case or outer spaces
provinces: most accounts, then posts, then name; at most eight; places by accounts then name
a row's post is the most recently published one, not the most recently collected

country_of.note: Indonesia, in any case and with outer spaces
a region is never abroad, in any case and with outer spaces
missing, empty, blank or not a text: unknown

shares.note: followers known on social posts, each group's and province's share of every X account, and provinces read
no social post and no X account: no share at all, never 0
followers known on the social posts and on their known interactions, news left out of both

lead.note: news only: one nameable row, so nothing is compared: no carrier and no most negative, however many posts are analysed
Threads only: the unknown row is never named, however many posts are analysed
a tier with 19 analysed posts is not named, the two tiers with 20 are compared; equal posts name no winner (a tie is no lead), the interactions do
the unknown row holds more posts and more known interactions than the leader: no winner on either, the gap with its platforms instead
ties: equal posts and equal interactions name no winner (a tie is no lead); equal negative shares go to more analysed posts, then to the earlier tier
a row with unknown interactions is not asked who has the most interactions; the unknown row outnumbers the leader on posts, so the gap is said instead
where: the province with the most accounts when 10 accounts have one; the share is of every X account (one tier: no carrier)
where: left out when only 9 accounts have a province (one tier: no carrier)
one nameable row beside the unknown row: nothing to compare, so no carrier and no most negative
the most negative needs two tiers with 20 analysed posts: beside one with 19, none is named
a lead equal to the unknown row's share names no winner, and an unknown row smaller than the leader is no gap to say
a lead one post and one interaction larger than the unknown row's share names the winner
a row with no negative post is never named the most negative
the unknown row with 20 analysed posts qualifies the most negative as outside the accounts whose follower count is unknown; it is less negative, so no clause
the platforms of a gap: the two largest by share, ties by name
shaped like the largest project: a near-tie on posts, the unknown row at 69% of known interactions mostly on Instagram and TikTok, and the most negative with 40 analysed posts

out: Sebanyak 69% dari interaksi yang tercatat berasal dari akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui; dari bagian ini, 68% di Instagram dan 31% di TikTok.

Paling negatif di luar akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui: akun <1 rb, 37% dari 68 posting yang dianalisis; akun yang pengikutnya tidak diketahui lebih negatif (55% dari 40 posting yang dianalisis).
